directive.quote: Native public_assets alias map explicit NEW generic pinned DATA delta, NOT historical field parity; MIME target-vs-alias/no-cache stablealias new constraints.
directive.source: Authorized coordinator assignment in the existing L101 owner case; not a new person message.

preserve: Public program and artwork bytes are the same for every reader and do not obtain account or operation authority.
GET returns exact asset bytes and their MIME; HEAD retains response metadata and returns no body.
Content-named program addresses retain year-long immutable caching, separately from stable asset addresses.
The existing native pinned-tree reader and bounded public-program admission remain the owner; aliases do not create a duplicate file server.
allowed_deltas: The native public_assets manifest map is NEW generic pinned DATA; none of the cited JavaScript sources had this field. It replaces the retired product dictionary with build-owned aliases to existing pinned workspace/named files.
The native map is deliberately confined to canonical root filenames and exact pinned targets; traversal, encoded aliases, private route names and physical tree collisions are refused at open.

Target-derived MIME and no-cache stable aliases are NEW constraints. The retired fixed dictionary associated MIME with each public URL and used a one-day stable-address cache; no historical equality of these policies is claimed.
Editable brand-role selection and remote brand redirects are outside this public static-alias change. No equivalence to the retired dynamic branding route is asserted.

The native adapter already existed in place before this change. Its original source/layout lineage is recorded separately; this cross-language contract covers only the public-asset behavior and explicit new constraints.
banned_substitutions: An invented prior-owner search, retrospective byte-copy assertion or claim that the public_assets field existed in the JavaScript owner.
A retired Worker, hardcoded product icon catalogue, arbitrary filesystem read, weakened current-session checks or immutable caching on stable aliases.
A claim that synthetic native tests or saved source establish an installed or customer-proved outcome.

baseline.source_state: Behavioral metadata restored after implementation. The cited immutable JavaScript ranges are behavioral evidence; no byte-copy ancestry from JavaScript to Rust is claimed.

native_owner.qualification: The complete pre-policy same-file source identity and history are verified. The separate source-first contract currently reports physical-line retention 0.3911 below 0.6 after the retained formatting changes; no source-first validation pass is claimed.

proof.qualification: Exact-tree public-assets controls: four passed, zero failed or ignored. Normal all-target build passed. Current private routes remain admitted; bytes, MIME, GET/HEAD, stable-alias caching, target caching and hostile alias/target cases were exercised. No public release or installation is claimed.

observed_port_judge.qualification: The actual repository port judge evaluated the exact committed source range and both current metadata files. This cross-language behavioral contract passed. The separate full Rust source-first metadata still reports its physical-line retention failure and supplies no source-first pass.
